fee_analysis.notes: Dated 2026-07-19 preliminary read-only Mantle mainnet sample: 101 consecutive recent blocks and 21 spaced points across 97,158,262–98,158,262 all showed baseFeePerGas=50 gwei and block gas limit=60,000,000 (evidence block 98121659 hash 0xc44bbf683065f56d14cfa1abf20fbdafdcc39e45e8071ea30e603a95228469ed). start_block_hash is the analysis-window identifier for block 97158262; end_block_hash is pinned to the documented evidence block. Current stability is not a permanent protocol constant; runtime must still consume live block-header base fee and gas limit at block ingress.

sampling_policy.description: Qualification samples (source fork_replay) are eth_estimateGas measurements, with stateOverride and never a broadcast, of the WHI-501 optimized runtime's production executeArbitrage calldata against real Mantle mainnet pools at a pinned block hash: WHI-557 (block 98478154, estimated on the read endpoint) and WHI-1422 (block 98969898, estimated on a local anvil fork; evidence/gas/whi-1422/REPORT.md). A same-block round trip through the same pools does not clear the executor's profit check, so each sample uses a recorded settlement lever (see its notes): WHI-557 nudges one hop's slot0/liquidity, bin or token balance; WHI-1422 uses v2_boost (overrides only a V2 hop's token balance), displace or inflate (rewrite V3/Moe pool state). These are lever-assisted fork estimates, not mainnet receipts or canonical-state replays (DI-10). The earlier Foundry gasleft() measurements against mock pools are kept as source foundry_mock: counted, never used for qualification or limits. Crossing buckets come from the production route-key simulation; zero-bucket samples never price crossing routes. Open-ended buckets and classes withheld by review (PR108-F2 factory exposure, PR108-F3 lever-state conservatism) are forced Unsupported with a recorded reason. Historical competitor receipts are research-only. Reverts are excluded from limits.

route_key_definition: ordered_protocols+hop_count+optional(v3_tick_crossings,moe_bin_crossings); V3/Moe buckets required when protocol present; labels ticks={0|1-5|6-20|21+} bins={0|1-3|4-10|11+}
